scope: Computer Control Phase 9B3A native NSOpenPanel Accessibility topology discovery
platform: macOS Cocoa/AppKit NSOpenPanel plus system-wide native Accessibility
purpose: discover the actual macOS 26.5.2 Accessibility ownership and hierarchy of a real NSOpenPanel before declaring any public file-picker API

safetyBoundary.cleanup: physical harness stops only its test-owned fixture and removes only its temporary test directory

expectedDiscovery: system-wide focused application is identified while NSOpenPanel is visible
at least one Accessibility-owned picker surface containing deterministic marker content is found
owner process name, bundle identifier and pid are recorded as discovery evidence
whether picker owner equals or differs from Provider host is recorded rather than assumed
AX window/tree topology containing picker marker content is recorded
no public 9B3 product capability is promoted by this discovery session
